title: Health Insurance Product Guide
content:
Health Insurance Product Guide
Available Plans

title: Customers can choose an individual health plan, family floater plan, or senior-s
content: Customers can choose an individual health plan, family floater plan, or senior-support review path. Plan suitability depends on age, city, coverage amount, budget, and medical disclosures. Hospitalization coverage includes in-patient treatment, ICU charges, and surgical procedures. Outpatient (OPD) coverage provides consultations, diagnostic tests, and pharmacy benefits under specified limits.

title: Family Coverage
content:
Family Coverage
Family floater coverage can include spouse and children under one shared coverage limit. The agent should collect each family member's age before suggesting a family floater. Dependents can include children up to age 25 and spouse under one unified policy limit.

title: Coverage Amount and Budget Options
content:
Coverage Amount and Budget Options
Common requested coverage ranges include 5 lakhs, 10 lakhs, and 25 lakhs. Monthly budget options range from 2,500 to 5,000 rupees depending on family size and riders selected. For budget-conscious applicants seeking lower premiums, hospitalization-only basic plans provide affordable coverage without outpatient riders. Exact premium quotes require advisor review.

title: Adding Spouse Later
content:
Adding Spouse Later
A spouse can usually be reviewed for addition at renewal or through an endorsement request, subject to policy terms and underwriting checks.

title: Claims Process
content:
Claims Process
For claims, the customer should contact the service team, share policy details, hospital or bill documents, and follow the insurer's cashless or reimbursement process.

title: Premium Objection and Affordable Options
content:
Premium Objection and Affordable Options
If the customer says the premium is high or expensive, explain benefits, suggest checking a lower coverage amount or a simpler hospitalization-only plan without extra riders, and offer advisor review. Do not promise unauthorized discounts.

title: Existing Insurance
content:
Existing Insurance
If the customer already has insurance, ask the renewal date and offer a comparison review before recommending any switch.

title: Qualification Rules
content:
Qualification Rules
- Adult applicants between 18 and 65 may be eligible depending on product.
- Information required to qualify includes applicant age, family member details, coverage preference, and monthly budget.
- Incomplete applications should be escalated for callback.
- If the caller asks for unavailable policy exclusions or unsupported investment advice, explain that the agent should verify with the human team or state information is unavailable.

title: Incomplete Application Handling
content:
Incomplete Application Handling
If required details are missing or conflicting (such as contradictory family member ages), do not guess. Collect the missing fields or escalate for a human callback.

title: Insurance Policy Renewal Guide
content:
Insurance Policy Renewal Guide
Policy renewal notice is sent 30 days before expiry. What happens during policy renewal: policyholders receive a notice and have a grace period of 30 days to pay the renewal premium. If premium remains unpaid after the grace period, the policy may lapse.
Note: For queries about "renwel" or renewal grace period, policyholders retain continuous coverage during the 30-day grace period.

title: Coverage continues only when the premium is received within the allowed period.

title: Branch Partnership Program
content:
# Branch Partnership Program
Branch Partnership Benefits

title: Operational, marketing, and technology support is provided to branch partners.
content:
Operational, marketing, and technology support is provided to branch partners.
Partners receive onboarding guidance, co-branded campaign materials, and access to product updates.

title: Eligibility
content:
Eligibility
Eligible partners must be licensed financial institutions or approved distribution partners.

title: Frequently Asked Questions
content:
Frequently Asked Questions
Q: What support do branch partners receive?
A: Partners receive operational support, marketing support, and implementation guidance.

title: Q: Who can apply?
content:
Q: Who can apply?
A: Licensed institutions and approved distribution partners may apply.
